integrity: Analytic proof derived from an exact two-angle transformation and complete elliptic-integral endpoint series; independent numerical quadrature is supplementary, not a certificate of infinite-domain statements. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent arclength-uniform boundary endpoints on ellipses; no claims for random-line chords, interior sampling, finite-sample inference, or maximal pairwise distances among many points. Fixed-eccentricity asymptotic is not uniform as eccentricity vanishes; double-scaling assumes finite parameter ratio. Literature priority remains provisional.
title: A logarithmic near-circle crossover for nearly diametral chords of ellipse boundaries
